title: Manna and Quail from Heaven

questions.question: What food did God send from heaven for the Israelites?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:31 (ESV): "The house of Israel called its name manna."

questions.question: What meat did God provide in the evening?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:13 (ESV): "In the evening quail came up and covered the camp."

questions.question: Why did the Israelites grumble against Moses in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:3 (ESV): "Would that we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots and ate bread to the full."

questions.question: What happened to manna left until morning?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:20 (ESV): "Some left part of it till the morning, and it bred worms and stank."

questions.question: What day were they not to gather manna?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:26 (ESV): "Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, which is a Sabbath, there will be none."

questions.question: How much manna were they to gather per person?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:16 (ESV): "Gather of it, each one of you, as much as he can eat. You shall each take an omer, according to the number of the persons."

questions.question: What happened on the sixth day regarding manna?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:22 (ESV): "On the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers each."

questions.question: What did manna taste like?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:31 (ESV): "It was like coriander seed, white, and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey."

questions.question: Where did the wilderness of Sin lie?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:1 (ESV): "The wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai."

questions.question: What did God say the manna would test?
options: Whether they would walk in His law or not
questions.correctAnswer: Whether they would walk in His law or not
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:4 (ESV): "That I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not."

questions.question: What was to be kept as a memorial of the manna?
options: An omer of manna kept before the Lord for generations
questions.correctAnswer: An omer of manna kept before the Lord for generations
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:33 (ESV): "Take a jar, and put an omer of manna in it, and place it before the Lord to be kept throughout your generations."

questions.question: How long did the Israelites eat manna?
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:35 (ESV): "The people of Israel ate the manna forty years, till they came to a habitable land."

questions.question: What did manna look like on the ground?
options: Fine, flake-like, fine as frost on the ground
questions.correctAnswer: Fine, flake-like, fine as frost on the ground
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:14 (ESV): "When the dew had gone up, there was on the face of the wilderness a fine, flake-like thing, fine as frost on the ground."

questions.question: What did Moses say the grumbling was really against?
options: Against the Lord, not against Moses and Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: Against the Lord, not against Moses and Aaron
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:8 (ESV): "Your grumbling is not against us but against the Lord."

questions.question: What appeared in the wilderness when God's glory was revealed?
options: The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud
questions.correctAnswer: The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud
questions.explanation: Exodus 16:10 (ESV): "They looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud."

key_verse_text: Then the Lord said to Moses, 'Behold, I am about to rain bread from heaven for you.'
